item.title: How nOps shipped FinOps agents 75% faster with Amazon Bedrock AgentCore
item.summary: nOps rebuilt its Clara FinOps AI agent on Amazon Bedrock AgentCore, replacing a self-managed Amazon EKS stack running LangChain and LangGraph. The move cut time-to-production by 75% (from 10-12 months to 4 months), improved response quality, and reduced operational overhead while keeping analytics governed through Databricks Lakehouse Metric Views.
